edges.qualification: Offer raises seasonal use; not a permanent habit or uniquely identified present-bias channel.

scope.configuration: Busia school-parent households offered early market-price fertilizer with free delivery for2004 seasons.

edges.dispute: Early versus late difference only p=.08; late effect not established as zero; no persistent use effect.

edges.qualification: Randomised trial-plus-summary exposure changes some measured practices; summary timing itself not independently randomised.

scope.configuration: Nusa Penida treated farmers, later personalised explanations after on-plot experiments,2007–08.

edges.dispute: Attention, calculation, credible instruction and elapsed learning are not separated; objective weight effect imprecise.

edges.qualification: Rewards operate through communicator effort and demonstrations; not a universal prerequisite for learning.

scope.configuration: Malawi2009–11 incentivised peer-communicator programme; pit-planting arm.

edges.dispute: Communicator identity and number confounded in lead-versus-peer contrast; reward can also signal priorities.

edges.qualification: Central targeting increases some diffusion metrics relative to benchmark selection; benchmark uptake remains possible.

scope.configuration: Two trained seeds per village;200-village Malawi experiment,2011–13.

edges.dispute: No necessity claim despite stronger wording in source; year3 rate contrast imprecise; complex contagion not uniquely identified.

edges.qualification: Hypothesised credibility mechanism for lower attendance at female-led demonstrations, not a demonstrated reduction in aggregate adoption.

scope.configuration: Gender-reserved versus unreserved communicator roles in143 villages,2009–11.

edges.dispute: Negative measured recipient beliefs coexist with comparable measured competence and imprecise pooled downstream differences; mediation not randomised.

edges.qualification: Specific fitting/orientation service package used with same hardware; not proven necessary for positive benefit.

scope.configuration: Indiana trial eligible first-time users; six-week audiology best-practice arm.

alternatives: Consumer preset selection with optional support
edges.dispute: Several outcomes similar with presets; benefit, satisfaction and logged use differ in sensitivity; calibration corrected.

edges.qualification: Preset self-selection is a functioning alternative within this clinic trial.

scope.configuration: Trial consumer-decides arm using three preset amplification profiles and same devices.

edges.dispute: Not all retail OTC models or users; lower satisfaction/preliminary keep intention; later rescue fitting confounds final between-arm retention.

edges.qualification: Active amplification improves specified hearing outcomes versus placebo; does not restore normal hearing generally.

scope.configuration: Mild-to-moderate loss in selected volunteers with same device hardware and blinded six-week comparisons.

edges.dispute: Daily hours did not significantly differ from placebo; use alone not sufficient outcome measure.

edges.qualification: Local identity meanings may discourage some purchases/use; support or indifference can offset them.

scope.configuration: Predominantly White Bay Area dyads aged60+ followed for one year.

edges.dispute: Interviews elicit meaning but do not identify causal magnitude; costs/benefit and retrospective rationalisation remain rivals.

edges.qualification: Exposure estimate concerns grade-age enrolment/completion, not directly measured bicycle use.

scope.configuration: Bihar2006–08 girls’ grade9 earmarked grant; cohort/gender/Jharkhand comparison.

alternatives: Changes in school location or provision
edges.dispute: Quasi-experimental assumptions; safety/norms/transport channels not individually separated.

edges.qualification: Proposed infrastructure contribution based on heterogeneous programme associations; road variable measures routes to health facilities.

scope.configuration: Bihar villages at least3km from secondary school in DLHS-3; health-facility all-weather access proxy.

edges.dispute: Road selection and measurement confounding; null unconnected estimate cannot establish necessity; same policy/survey lineage asS10.

edges.qualification: Trained mechanics make local servicing available in both treatment arms; independent maintenance effect unmeasured.

scope.configuration: Zambia2017 school-distributed bicycles with school-linked repair support.

edges.dispute: Component included by design; no bicycle-only or repair-only arm; do not infer causal durability magnitude.

edges.qualification: Primary school-use condition and four-year resale prohibition restrict asset discretion.

scope.configuration: Zambia2017 custody contract and school supervisory committee.

edges.dispute: Enforcement and intrahousehold autonomy not fully measured; conditions can coexist with benefits.

edges.qualification: Installed bicycle/support package reduces commute time in eligible population.

scope.configuration: Zambia grade5–7 girls initially walking>3km;100-school randomisation and2018 follow-up.

edges.dispute: Not a single-component test; out-of-school girls outside target and urban/some very remote schools excluded. Disability/cycling-ability representation and route accessibility not established; self-report and attrition limits.
